The '''Rabbit Hole''' is a variation on the [[Dig Site]], used only for the [[Egg Hunting]] [[Course]] on the [[Challenge Mode]] [[Campus]], [[Egg & Silver-Spoon Race]]. It features a different surface texture, that of a daisy meadow, and the [[Entrance (Dig Site)|Entrance]] retains a different appearance, but elsewise functions similarly to the Dig Site, and includes the same [[items]].

The main difference is in the [[Seasonal Eggs]] which are excavated in place of [[Artefacts]]. Whereas the number of Artefacts that can be unearthed in the Dig Site is only limited by its size, the Rabbit Hole will host a maximum of ten Seasonal Eggs per excavation. In addition, the Seasonal Eggs do not appreciate in value over time, thus Large Seasonal Eggs will always sell for $200, and Small Seasonal Eggs for $100.

==Description==
===Function===
[[Students]] can visit this room to complete their [[#Classes|Classes]] and [[Assignments]]. [[Students]] during classes can dig up special [[items]], called {{i2|Seasonal Eggs|25px|alt=Seasonal-Egg-Icon|br=no}}. A bigger Rabbit Hole has a higher chance of finding more Seasonal Eggs, up to a maximum of 10 per dig. These [[items]] can be sold for money or displayed on Campus to increase [[Attractiveness]] and [[Prestige]]. Each Rabbit Hole will reset, shortly after the [[Students]] reached the bottom of the pit, prior to the next dig commencing.

Rabbit Hole [[items]] can only be placed at the edge of the room.

===Unlock===
